name: Q2
outlook:
What Q2 says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: total revenue and adjusted EBITDAQ2 Holdings is providing guidance for the fourth quarter of 2026 as follows: • Total revenue of $226.0 million to $230.0 million, which would represent year-over-year growth of 9 to 10 percent. • Adjusted EBITDA of $62.4 million to $65.4 million, representing 28 percent of revenue for the quarter.
  • Full year 2026: total revenue and adjusted EBITDAQ2 Holdings is providing updated guidance for the full-year 2026 as follows: • Total revenue of $888.0 million to $892.0 million, which would represent year-over-year growth of 12 percent. • Adjusted EBITDA of $253.0 million to $256.0 million, representing 28 to 29 percent to of revenue for the year.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 28, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
